description: Java class implementing a WearableListenerService that handles data and message events from wearable devices, manages GoogleApiClient connection, and triggers activities based on received messages.

classes.name: DataLayerListenerService
classes.description: A service that listens for data and message events from wearable devices, manages GoogleApiClient connection, and initiates activities based on messages.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles data change events, connects to GoogleApiClient if needed, and sends messages based on data item paths.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, starts MainActivity if the message path matches.

methods.name: LOGD
methods.description: Logs debug messages if log level permits.
